mcqs.question: Who won the women's title at the Asian Individual Chess Championship 2026 held in Ulaanbaatar?
mcqs.explanation: Savitha Shri Bhasker won the women's Asian Individual Chess Championship 2026 with 7.5/9 points on a tie-break. Kang Xiangrui won the open title, while R. Praggnanandhaa and Viswanathan Anand were not the women's champion.
